### Types of Variables and Their Graphs


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df_flights <- read.csv("data/df_flights_enriched.csv")
```
:::


| Graph        | Variables                    | Shows                               | ggplot2            |
|--------------|------------------------------|-------------------------------------|--------------------|
| Histogram    | 1 continuous                 | distribution of a variable          | `geom_histogram()` |
| Bar chart    | 1 categorical                | number of observations per category | `geom_bar()`       |
| Box plot     | 1 continuous + 1 categorical | distribution within each category   | `geom_boxplot()`   |
| Scatter plot | 2 continuous                 | relationship between two variables  | `geom_point()`     |
| Line graph   | 1 continuous + time          | evolution of a variable over time   | `geom_line()`      |


### The `ggplot2` Package


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
install.packages("ggplot2")
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(ggplot2)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}

```
Warning: package 'ggplot2' was built under R version 4.5.2
```


:::
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Histogram of arrival delays
ggplot(df_flights, aes(x = arr_delay)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  labs(x = "Arrival delay (minutes)", y = "Frequency")
```

```r
# Scatterplot of air time against distance
ggplot(df_flights, aes(x = distance, y = air_time)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Distance (miles)", y = "Air time (minutes)")
```

## Histogram

```r
ggplot(df, aes(x = income)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20)
```

```r
ggplot(df, aes(x = income)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  facet_wrap(~ gender, ncol = 1)
```

## Bar Chart

```r
ggplot(df, aes(x = education)) +
  geom_bar()
```

```r
ggplot(df, aes(x = education, fill = gender)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Box Plot

```r
ggplot(df, aes(x = education, y = income)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```

```r
ggplot(df, aes(x = education, y = income,
               fill = gender)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Scatter Plot

```r
ggplot(df, aes(x = age, y = income)) +
  geom_point()
```

```r
ggplot(df, aes(x = age, y = income,
               colour = gender)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
```

## Line Graph

```r
ggplot(df_ts[df_ts$country == "A", ],
       aes(x = year, y = unemp)) +
  geom_line()
```

```r
ggplot(df_ts, aes(x = year, y = unemp,
                  colour = country)) +
  geom_line()
```
